description: Speculation and preferences stay notes. On a startup script, the reviewer worried a slow download might time out: nothing shows it will, and it is an optional hardening suggestion, so it doesn't block, one-shot path or not. A naming preference the reviewer inferred itself (no written team rule) is a note too.

findings.title: A slow download might time out
findings.body: If the mirror is slow during provisioning, the download might time out and the startup script would throw. Nothing shows the mirror is slow; a retry would be nice to have.

findings.title: Prefer an early return
findings.body: Returning early would read more clearly than the nested if.
